description.value: The Rose Neighbourhood Public House occupies a converted 1925 heritage home in Colwood that has anchored the Westshore community as a pub under various names since 1985. The current owners relaunched it in 2018 with house-crafted cocktails, cold draught, and hearty pub fare including house-smoked fish chowder and hand-cut fries. A backyard garden provides extra outdoor seating, giving the place an inviting stop-and-stay feel for anyone passing through the Westshore.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at therosepublichouse.com confirms the business rebranded from 'Country Rose Pub' to 'The Rose Neighbourhood Public House' in 2018, and locates it in Colwood BC rather than Victoria. Takeout is explicitly offered ('for in-room dining & take out (pick up only)') and the food menu lists a gluten-free bun substitute option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Country Rose Pub' is outdated; the business rebranded to 'The Rose Neighbourhood Public House' in 2018 — OSM record should be updated.
OSM 'community' metadata lists Victoria, but the website and business self-identify as Colwood, BC.
No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.
No bike parking or cycling-specific amenities confirmed from website; on-site visit recommended to assess rack availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active neighbourhood pub with a full food menu, confirmed takeout, and a backyard patio — a solid food-and-drink waypoint for cyclists exploring Colwood and the Westshore.
